story.text: 김해공항 국내선 도착장은 캐리어 바퀴 소리와 안내 방송이 뒤섞여 늘 어수선하다. 인파를 헤치고 걷다가, 저만치 낯익은 뒷모습에 걸음이 저절로 멈춘다.
story.reading: gim-hae-gong-hang guk-nae-seon do-chak-jang-eun kae-ri-eo ba-kwi so-ri-wa an-nae bang-song-i dwi-seok-yeo neul eo-su-seon-ha-da. in-pa-reul he-chi-go geot-da-ga, jeo-man-chi nat-ik-eun dwit-mo-seup-e geol-eum-i jeo-jeol-lo meom-chun-da.
story.en: Gimhae Airport's domestic arrivals hall is always a jumble of suitcase-wheel rumble and boarding announcements. Weaving through the crowd, a familiar back up ahead makes my feet stop on their own.

story.text: "야! 이게 누고, 진짜! 이래 딱 마주칠 줄은 몰랐다." 뒤돌아본 선우의 눈이 커지더니, 금세 장난기로 휘어진다.
story.reading: ya! i-ge nu-go, jin-jja! i-rae ttak ma-ju-chil jul-eun mol-lat-da. dwi-dol-a-bon seon-u-ui nun-i keo-ji-deo-ni, geum-se jang-nan-gi-ro hwi-eo-jin-da.
story.en: "Hey! No way, is that you! I seriously didn't think I'd run into you like this." Sunwoo turns around, his eyes going wide before instantly curving into a grin full of mischief.

story.text: 아직 기장 유니폼 차림 그대로다. 견장의 금색 줄이 조명 아래 반짝이고, 넥타이는 반쯤 풀려 있다. 방금 비행을 마치고 게이트에서 막 나온 모양이다.
story.reading: a-jik gi-jang yu-ni-pom cha-rim geu-dae-ro-da. gyeon-jang-ui geum-saek jul-i jo-myeong a-rae ban-jjak-i-go, nek-ta-i-neun ban-jjeum pul-lyeo it-da. bang-geum bi-haeng-eul ma-chi-go ge-i-teu-e-seo mak na-on mo-yang-i-da.
story.en: He's still in his captain's uniform. The gold stripes on his shoulder boards catch the light, his tie half-loosened. He looks like he just walked off a flight from the gate.

story.text: "니 걸음걸이가 저짝에서부터 딱 '낯익어가' 혹시나 했다. 진짜 니 맞네."
story.reading: ni geol-eum-geo-ri-ga jeo-jjak-e-seo-bu-teo ttak nat-ik-eo-ga hok-si-na haet-da. jin-jja ni man-ne.
story.en: "The way you were walking looked familiar all the way from over there, so I had a hunch. And it really is you."

story.text: "이야, 진짜 '반갑다' 이거. 니 부산은 웬일이고? 여행이가, 아니면 또 뭔 일 있어가 왔나?"
story.reading: i-ya, jin-jja ban-gap-da i-geo. ni bu-san-eun wen-il-i-go? yeo-haeng-i-ga, a-ni-myeon tto mwon il it-eo-ga wan-na?
story.en: "Man, I'm seriously glad to see you. What brings you to Busan? A trip, or did something come up and you had to come?"

story.text: "참, 나 오늘 하늘이 비행 끝나면 같이 커피 마시기로 했었는데. 걔랑 내랑 입사 동기 아이가. 근데 니 만났으니까 그건 다음에 무야지. …니는 진짜 '여전하네', 하나도 안 변했다."
story.reading: cham, na o-neul ha-neul-i bi-haeng kkeut-na-myeon gat-i keo-pi ma-si-gi-ro haet-eot-neun-de. gyae-rang nae-rang ip-sa dong-gi a-i-ga. geun-de ni man-nat-eu-ni-kka geu-geon da-eum-e mu-ya-ji. …ni-neun jin-jja yeo-jeon-ha-ne, ha-na-do an byeon-haet-da.
story.en: "Oh right, I was supposed to grab coffee with Haneul after his flight today — he and I started at the airline the same year, we're 동기. But now that I've run into you, that can wait. …You're seriously the same as always, haven't changed one bit."

story.text: "마지막으로 본 게 언젠지도 가물가물한데, 시간 진짜 '훌쩍' 가삤네. 아 몰라, 아무튼 반가운께 오늘 시간 있으면 나랑 좀 놀자."
story.reading: ma-ji-mak-eu-ro bon ge eon-jen-ji-do ga-mul-ga-mul-han-de, si-gan jin-jja hul-jjeok ga-ppan-ne. a mol-la, a-mu-teun ban-ga-un-kke o-neul si-gan it-eu-myeon na-rang jom nol-ja.
story.en: "I can't even remember when we last saw each other, time really flew right by. Ugh, whatever — anyway, I'm glad you're here, so if you've got time today, hang out with me a bit."

story.text: "단어부터 챙기고 가자. 이번 챕터도 대화 문제 있으니까, 무슨 상황인지 잘 읽고 맞혀봐라."
story.reading: dan-eo-bu-teo chaeng-gi-go ga-ja. i-beon chaeb-teo-do dae-hwa mun-je it-eu-ni-kka, mu-seun sang-hwang-in-ji jal ilg-go mach-yeo-bwa-ra.
story.en: "Let's grab the vocab first. This chapter's got a conversation question too, so read carefully and figure out what's going on."

words.meaning: To run into, bump into (someone), for eyes to meet
words.example_en: I ran into an old friend by chance at the airport.
Even though it was an alley I'd never been to, it felt strangely familiar.

words.meaning: To be glad, happy to see someone
words.example_en: I'm so glad to see you after such a long time.

words.meaning: To be the same as always, unchanged
words.example: 몇 년이 지나도 그의 성격은 여전하다.
words.example_reading: myeot nyeon-i ji-na-do geu-ui seong-gyeok-eun yeo-jeon-ha-da
words.example_en: Even after several years, his personality is still the same.

words.meaning: (of time) in a flash, all at once
words.example: 이야기를 나누다 보니 시간이 훌쩍 지나갔다.
words.example_reading: i-ya-gi-reul na-nu-da bo-ni si-gan-i hul-jjeok ji-na-gat-da
words.example_en: While we were talking, time flew by in a flash.

sentences.ko: 공항 도착장에서 우연히 옛 친구를 마주쳤다.
sentences.reading: gong-hang do-chak-jang-e-seo u-yeon-hi yet chin-gu-reul ma-ju-chyeot-da
sentences.en: At the airport arrivals hall, I ran into an old friend by chance.
Even though it was an alley I'd never seen before, it felt strangely familiar.

sentences.ko: 오랜만에 만난 그의 얼굴을 보니 정말 반가웠다.
sentences.reading: o-raen-man-e man-nan geu-ui eol-gul-eul bo-ni jeong-mal ban-ga-wot-da
sentences.en: Seeing his face after so long, I was truly glad.

sentences.ko: 몇 년이 지났는데도 그의 장난기는 여전했다.
sentences.reading: myeot nyeon-i ji-nat-neun-de-do geu-ui jang-nan-gi-neun yeo-jeon-haet-da
sentences.en: Even after several years, his playful streak was still the same.

sentences.ko: 이야기를 나누다 보니 시간이 훌쩍 지나가 있었다.
sentences.reading: i-ya-gi-reul na-nu-da bo-ni si-gan-i hul-jjeok ji-na-ga it-eot-da
sentences.en: While we were talking, time had flown by in a flash.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 헥, 헥. 뛰어왔다, 니 여기 있는 거 보고. 방금 비행 끝나자마자 바로 온 거다.
turns.reading: hek, hek. ttwi-eo-wat-da, ni yeo-gi it-neun geo bo-go. bang-geum bi-haeng kkeut-na-ja-ma-ja ba-ro on geo-da.
turns.en: Huff, huff. I ran over the second I spotted you here. I came straight from finishing my flight.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 유니폼도 안 갈아입고 그냥 온 거야?
turns.reading: yu-ni-pom-do an gal-a-ip-go geu-nyang on geo-ya?
turns.en: You came straight here without even changing out of your uniform?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 그래야제, 니 놓칠까 봐. 이런 데서 마주치는 거 흔한 일 아이다, 진짜.
turns.reading: geu-rae-ya-je, ni noch-il-kka bwa. i-reon de-seo ma-ju-chi-neun geo heun-han il a-i-da, jin-jja.
turns.en: Had to, in case I missed you. Running into you in a place like this really doesn't happen often.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Was it really worth running for?

dialogues.question: 선우는 왜 유니폼도 갈아입지 않고 뛰어왔나요?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Sunwoo run over without even changing out of his uniform?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 우연히 마주친 승객을 놓칠까 봐 유니폼도 갈아입지 않고 서둘러 달려왔습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 근데 진짜 신기하다. 이 넓은 공항에서 어떻게 딱 마주치노.
turns.reading: geun-de jin-jja sin-gi-ha-da. i neol-beun gong-hang-e-seo eo-tteo-ke ttak ma-ju-chi-no.
turns.en: But it's seriously amazing. How do we just run into each other in an airport this huge.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 그러니까 말이다. 이거 무슨 인연 아이가 싶다.
turns.reading: geu-reo-ni-kka mal-i-da. i-geo mu-seun in-yeon a-i-ga sip-da.
turns.en: That's what I'm saying. Feels like it's gotta be some kind of fate.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 인연은 무슨. 니 원래 공항이 직장이잖아.
turns.reading: in-yeon-eun mu-seun. ni won-lae gong-hang-i jik-jang-i-jan-a.
turns.en: What fate. The airport is literally your workplace.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 아, 맞다 그렇네. …아무튼! 반가운 건 반가운 거니까, 오늘 시간 있으면 나랑 좀 놀자, 어?
turns.reading: a, mat-da geu-reon-ne. …a-mu-teun! ban-ga-un geon ban-ga-un geo-ni-kka, o-neul si-gan it-eu-myeon na-rang jom nol-ja, eo?
turns.en: Oh, right, huh. …Anyway! Glad is glad, so if you've got time today, hang out with me a bit, okay?

dialogues.question: 선우의 마지막 말에서 알 수 있는 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What can be inferred from Sunwoo's last line?
dialogues.correct_answer: 우연한 만남을 핑계 삼아 함께 시간을 보내고 싶어 한다
options: 우연한 만남을 핑계 삼아 함께 시간을 보내고 싶어 한다
공항 업무 때문에 빨리 자리를 떠야 한다
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 스스로 인연 운운하다 무안해하면서도, 결국 승객과 함께 시간을 보내고 싶은 마음을 슬쩍 드러냅니다.
